Patient Privacy Protection
It is not permissible under the Health Information Portability & Accountability Act (HIPAA) or Penn Medicine policy to share patient or research participant information in connection with open or public AI tools and services, such as ChatGPT. claims.claimText: It is not permissible under HIPAA or Penn Medicine policy to share patient or research participant information with open or public AI tools and services such as ChatGPT; individual patient data and data sets (even if deidentified) may not be exposed to such tools absent institutional approval.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Patient Privacy Protection
It is not permissible under the Health Information Portability & Accountability Act (HIPAA) or Penn Medicine policy to share patient or research participant information in connection with open or public AI tools and services, such as ChatGPT. This is because, as currently configured, such open or public tools and services can use and share any data without regard to HIPAA restrictions and other protections. Therefore, individual patient data and patient data sets (even if deidentified) may not be exposed to open or public AI tools or services, absent institutional approval.

coursework.en: AI use depends on the instructor and assignment. Penn has no standardized student AI-use policy; without other guidance, treat AI as assistance from another person. Wharton Academy examples apply only to that program and require instructor permission.

exams.en: No uniform university-wide AI exam permission was established. Follow the specific assessment rules; Wharton Academy expressly prohibits AI cheating in its exams and tests. Tool availability grants no exam permission.
exams.zh: 未建立全校统一 AI 考试许可；须核对具体考核规则。Wharton Academy 明确禁止在其考试中用 AI 作弊；工具开放不构成考试许可。

disclosure.en: Community guidance directs transparency and disclosure, while stating it is not a final policy. Instructors may impose specific citation/disclosure requirements; Wharton Academy treats uncredited AI work as plagiarism.
disclosure.zh: 社区指导要求透明说明 AI 使用，同时声明并非最终政策。教师可规定具体引用与披露要求；Wharton Academy 将未注明来源的 AI 内容视为抄袭。

privacy_data.en: Protect student, patient and research data. Unlicensed tools must not receive identifiable student information; student work requires permission even if anonymized. Do not require personal information or IP in unlicensed tools. Licensed-tool data conditions differ.
privacy_data.zh: 保护学生、患者及研究数据。未许可工具不得接收可识别学生信息；上传学生作品即使匿名也须获许可。不得要求学生向未许可工具输入个人信息或知识产权；许可工具数据条件各异。

approved_tools.en: Institutional tools have product-specific audience, account, cost and data conditions. PennChat requires PennKey and campus/VPN access; verify current entitlements with IT. Tool access is separate from assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: 机构工具各有人员资格、账号、费用与数据条件。PennChat 须用 PennKey 并在校园网络或 VPN 访问；具体资格向 IT 核对。工具可获取与考核许可分别判断。

research_publication.en: Consult department leadership and discipline publication standards about AI authorship. Research-participant data requires appropriate consent and prior IRB approval; data/IP safeguards and Penn Center for Innovation consultation apply.
research_publication.zh: 研究署名须咨询部门及学科发表标准；研究参与者数据须遵守知情同意并事先取得 IRB 批准，还须遵守数据与知识产权条件，涉及知识产权咨询 Penn Center for Innovation。

academic_integrity.en: Course rules determine unauthorized AI assistance. Wharton Academy has its own restrictions. CETLI advises discussing suspected misuse with students and consulting CSA; it says not to upload work into AI detectors and rejects their accuracy as misconduct evidence. Formal hearing/appeal procedures remain a gap.
academic_integrity.zh: 未经许可的 AI 协助由课程规则判断，Wharton Academy 另有项目限制。CETLI 建议与学生沟通并可咨询 CSA，明确不要向 AI 检测器上传作品，检测结果不足以作为不端证据。正式听证与申诉程序仍待补证。

teaching_guidance.en: Instructors set and communicate course/assignment expectations. Unlicensed tools must not require student personal information or IP; consider licensed tools for mandatory coursework. Investigate suspected misuse through conversation and appropriate consultation.
